He pursued an academic career and was recognized for his expertise in legal theory and practice. Unfortunately, detailed information about his personal life, including his education and specific academic positions, is limited in general public sources.

Güterbock's work would have existed during a time when Germany was undergoing significant changes, spanning the German Empire, World War I, the Weimar Republic, and the rise of the Nazi regime. His later life and career would have been impacted by the political upheavals and societal changes that characterized early 20th-century Germany, culminating in the onset of World War II.

Not all aspects of his work or his influence in the legal domain are widely documented today, which is why information in publicly available records may be sparse unless accessed through academic journals or specialized historical legal texts.
